scientific_integrity: Original face weights and the constructive reweighting are distinguished; general diagonal-scaling algorithms and inherited-weight spectral formulas are acknowledged as prior art. Symbolic and finite rational checks are supplements to an analytical proof, not independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Only one weighted tetrahedral one-up-Laplacian, a fixed omitted face and a positive one-parameter weight family; the optimum is asymptotic, not an exact finite-parameter optimizer. The heavy-subcomplex face-selection procedure is not assessed; floating-point and general-complex performance are unproved.
title: A sharp bounded-conditioning rescue for a fixed-face tetrahedral Hodge preconditioner
